clean_repro.observed: Request succeeded with HTTP 200 and returned empty array: {"code":0,"data":[]}. API accepts empty collectionName parameter.

violated_assumptions: Oracle assumes collectionName should be required for aliases+list endpoint
Oracle expects empty collectionName to be rejected with validation error
Oracle compares aliases+list behavior with collections+describe, but these are different endpoints with different semantics

contract_refs: Endpoint: aliases+list - List aliases, optionally filtered by collection
Parameter: collectionName (type: string, required: false, description: Filter by collection)
This matches the OptionalCollectionNameReq struct which has no binding:'required' tag

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: REST v2 handler_v2.go:listAlias() → uses OptionalCollectionNameReq (no binding:'required') → passes collectionName to proxy.ListAliases → returns empty list when no filter specified
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:listAlias 使用 OptionalCollectionNameReq 结构体,该结构体无 binding:'required' 标签,与需要必填的 CollectionNameReq 形成对比。aliases+list 端点设计为可选过滤:不提供 collectionName 时返回所有别名,提供时返回指定集合的别名。这是有意的设计,非遗漏。

falsification.probe: Compare aliases+list (empty collectionName) vs collections+describe (empty collectionName)
falsification.observed: aliases+list with empty collectionName returns empty list (valid behavior - no aliases exist), collections+describe rejects empty collectionName (different endpoint semantics). Both behaviors are consistent with their respective contracts.

cognition_match.developer_quote: aliases+list accepts optional collectionName filter; empty string means list all aliases in database
cognition_match.note: 未命中明确 by_design_patterns,但源码与契约一致显示这是有意设计:collectionName 是可选过滤参数,空值表示不过滤,返回所有别名。

contract.explicit_requirement: aliases+list: collectionName is optional (required: false, description: 'Filter by collection')

verdicts.rationale: Oracle 误解了 aliases+list 端点的语义。契约明确定义 collectionName 为可选参数(required: false,描述:'Filter by collection'),源码中使用 OptionalCollectionNameReq 结构体(无 binding:'required' 标签)实现这一设计。空 collectionName 表示不过滤,返回数据库中所有别名,返回空数组是因为当前没有别名,非错误行为。collections+describe 要求必填 collectionName 是因为其语义是描述特定集合,而 aliases+list 是列出别名(可按集合过滤),两者端点语义不同。这是正确实现,非遗漏。
